Select only Apple Pay, Google Pay and Shop Pay in the actual native picker. Verify those three checked and all other choices unchecked. Freshly reload Business info Details and Accepted payment methods. Record actual saved wallet names, any pending/review/approved state, account identity and readback time. If reviewed entries are not immediately listed, preserve the actual pending state or missing persistence as unresolved; do not repeatedly add or claim success. No checkout/payment transaction is necessary for this declaration review.
Stop for identity mismatch, login, policy/permission rejection, billing/provider onboarding or any action beyond declarations. Preserve unrelated concurrent settings.

rollback.action: If erroneous, remove only Apple Pay, Google Pay and Shop Pay declarations added by this exact operation, using the normal remove/Confirm/Save flow and a truthful displayed removal reason; then reload to verify. Do not deactivate Shopify wallets or remove concurrently added methods.
